# Expense request: the longest a ticket takes

File: `expense.ringi` (the request `expense`, version 1, sha256:058e89be8b5bcb64).

Kept by the team Accounting (`accounting`).

The organization is read in each of its versions: from 2026-04-01 and 2027-04-01.

## The longest a ticket takes

A ticket of this request ends within 93 business days at the most:

| What | Business days |
|---|---|
| The longest path of the route, 4 times: once, and again each time it is sent back | 4 × 21 |
| With the requester, to submit it again, 3 times | 3 × 3 |
| In all | 93 |

## The longest path

It is the path of the requests of this case: Category: Expenses; Amount: more than 100,000 JPY and 1,000,000 JPY or less.

| Stage | Who answers | Deadline | When it is late | Business days at the most |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| precheck | check | 3 business days, at the end of the day | goes up as the table `next_up` says, then expires | 7 |
| first | manager | 3 business days, at the end of the day | goes up as the table `next_up` says, then expires | 7 |
| decide | dept_head | 3 business days, at the end of the day | goes up as the table `next_up` says, then expires | 7 |

One round of this path takes 21 business days at the most.

From 2026-04-03 (Fri) to 2026-08-07 (Fri): 90 business days.

> No ticket takes longer than 93 business days, whatever the days the calendar closes; a ticket that takes all of them need not be there. On these dates it takes fewer: where a deadline at the end of a day runs out on the eve of a day the calendar closes, the stage goes up on the closed day, which is not a business day, and so takes one business day less.

## What shortens it

Each row changes one thing of the request, and says what the longest becomes, counted the same way: where another path becomes the longest, it is counted on that path.

| Change | The longest becomes | Shorter by |
|---|---|---|
| Every stage due in 2 business days instead of 3 business days | 69 | 24 |
| Sent back at most 2 times instead of 3 times | 69 | 24 |
| Submitted again within 2 business days instead of 3 business days | 90 | 3 |
